name: AWS Activate Startup Credits
free_limit: Approved startups can receive one-time AWS promotional credits: self-funded Activate Founders starts at $1,000, with selected applicants eligible up to $5,000; eligible Activate Portfolio startups may receive up to $200,000. Credits cover eligible AWS services, not a recurring free allowance.
watch_out: Startup must be under 10 years old and pre-Series B; Portfolio tier requires an Activate Provider organization ID. An AWS paid-tier account is required. Approved award, eligible services, credit validity and AWS Promotional Credit Terms depend on the offer. Charges beyond eligible credit balances are payable; approval and maximum award are not guaranteed.
